Refund Policy — the One-Event Pass

Effective: November 20, 2026

Seller: No Guesswork Systems LLC, a Maryland limited liability company, 306 W Redwood St, Ste 201, Baltimore, MD 21201

Questions and requests: events@noguessworksystems.com

1. What you are buying

The One-Event Pass is a single purchase of $39 (USD) that unlocks the paid parts of planning for one event: sharing vendor briefs beyond the first one, destination and multi-day planning, and the features the app names as covered by the pass when it asks.

  • It is one event, one time. It is not a subscription. Nothing renews, nothing is charged again, and you will never be billed without going through checkout yourself.
  • The price is set by us at checkout and is not editable by the app or by you.
  • Planning itself stays free. You can plan an event end to end, run the day, and send one vendor brief without buying anything. The pass is for the parts that go beyond that, and the app tells you which ones before it asks.
  • Vendors are never charged. No fee is taken from any vendor, caterer, or venue, and none ever will be.

Payment is taken on Stripe's hosted checkout page. We do not see or store your card details. Your receipt comes from Stripe.

2. When the pass takes effect

Immediately after a successful payment. If you return from checkout and the event still shows as locked, wait a few seconds — the confirmation from Stripe can arrive after you do — and reload. If it is still locked after a minute, email us with your Stripe receipt and we will fix it the same day.

3. Refunds — the rule

Refunds. You may get a full refund within 14 days of buying the pass, with no questions asked, as long as no new vendor brief has been sent from that event since you bought it. Once a new brief has been sent, the pass has done its job and the purchase is final. If the pass did not work for you, section 4 applies at any time.

These also apply:

  • Outside the window, the purchase is final. We will still make it right if the pass did not work — section 4.
  • We refund to the original payment method, through Stripe. Stripe typically posts a refund within 5–10 business days; the timing after that is your card issuer's.
  • A full refund revokes the pass. The event returns to the free tier; nothing you planned is deleted.
  • A partial refund keeps the pass. If we refund part of the price, the event keeps everything the pass unlocked.
  • A refunded event cannot buy the pass again at checkout. Checkout refuses any event with a recorded purchase and points you to us instead; write to events@noguessworksystems.com if you want the pass back on that event.
  • One refund per pass. A pass that has been refunded cannot be refunded a second time.
  • A refund turns the pass off for anything new. Vendor briefs you already sent keep working.

4. When we refund regardless of the window

If the pass did not do what it says — it never unlocked, it unlocked the wrong event, you were charged twice, or the feature it covers was broken for you — tell us and we will refund or fix it, whichever you prefer, regardless of timing. A broken product is not a change of mind.

5. How to ask

Email events@noguessworksystems.com from the address on your account with the Stripe receipt (or the last four digits of the card and the date). We answer within two business days and, if the request falls inside the rule above, we issue the refund in the same reply. You do not need to give a reason, though if the pass fell short we would like to know how.

6. Chargebacks

If you dispute the charge with your card issuer instead of writing to us, the pass is switched off as soon as Stripe tells us about the dispute — before the dispute is decided — and the event returns to the free tier; nothing you planned is deleted. If the dispute is later decided in our favor, the pass does not come back on its own; write to us. We will provide Stripe with the purchase record. We would much rather refund you directly — it is faster for you and cheaper for us — so please write first.

7. Changes

If this policy changes, the new version applies to purchases made after its effective date. The policy in force when you bought your pass is the one that applies to it.

Effective November 20, 2026. Questions: events@noguessworksystems.com
